        clauses.append([-a, -b, -z])
        clauses.append([a, -b, z])
        clauses.append([-a, b, z])
        return z

        if a is None or b is None:
            return None
        if a == b:
            return a
        z = new_var()
        clauses.append([-a, -b, z])
        clauses.append([a, -z])
        clauses.append([b, -z])
        return z

        unique = []

        z = new_var()

        carry    = majority(a, b, cin)

        p = and2(a, b)
        q = and2(a, cin)
        r = and2(b, cin)
        cout = or_of([p, q, r])
        return s, cout

    xs = [new_var() for _ in numbers]

    for i, num in enumerate(numbers):

        else:

                clauses.append([-cur[k]])
